items.t: Vertex Stocks Fall 7.06% as FDA Pushes Kidney Drug Decision to 2027
items.sum: The agency extended its povetacicept review by up to three months after a late-cycle information request, moving the deadline to February 28.

items.t: Here's Why Vera Therapeutics Stock Surged Today (Hint: It's Not Great News For Vertex Shareholders)
items.sum: Some bad news from the developer of a rival drug lifted Vera's stock today.

items.t: Vertex shares drop after FDA delays kidney drug decision
items.sum: Investing.com -- Vertex Pharmaceuticals shares fell 7% Friday morning in New York after the U.S. Food and Drug Administration pushed back its decision on the company's chronic kidney disease treatment by up to three months.

items.t: Citi Says Vertex’s Povetacicept Delay Is ‘Not Thesis Changing,’ Maintains Its ‘Buy’ Rating
items.sum: Citi maintained its ‘Buy’ rating and $585 price target on Vertex Pharmaceuticals, according to The Fly.
